script = '''\
import fitz
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import io
import os

pdf_path = "uploads/handbook.pdf"
if not os.path.exists(pdf_path):
    # Try alternate locations
    for candidate in ["handbook.pdf", "./handbook.pdf"]:
        if os.path.exists(candidate):
            pdf_path = candidate
            break

print(f"Opening PDF: {pdf_path}")
doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)
print(f"Total pages: {len(doc)}")

# --- Step 1: Extract text from all pages ---
print("\\n" + "="*60)
print("STEP 1: TEXT EXTRACTION (all pages)")
print("="*60)
all_text = []
for i, page in enumerate(doc):
    text = page.get_text()
    all_text.append(text)
    preview = text[:200].replace("\\n", " ").strip()
    print(f"  Page {i+1}: {len(text)} chars | Preview: {preview}...")

full_text = "\\n".join(all_text)

# Save extracted text
with open("output/handbook_extracted_text.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(full_text)
print(f"\\nFull extracted text saved to output/handbook_extracted_text.txt ({len(full_text)} chars total)")

# --- Step 2: OCR on first page image ---
print("\\n" + "="*60)
print("STEP 2: OCR ON FIRST PAGE IMAGE")
print("="*60)

first_page = doc[0]
# Render first page to image at 300 DPI for good OCR quality
mat = fitz.Matrix(300/72, 300/72)
pix = first_page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat)
img_data = pix.tobytes("png")
img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_data))

# Save the first page image
img.save("output/handbook_page1.png")
print(f"First page image saved to output/handbook_page1.png ({img.size[0]}x{img.size[1]} px)")

# Perform OCR
ocr_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)
with open("output/handbook_page1_ocr.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(ocr_text)
print(f"OCR text saved to output/handbook_page1_ocr.txt ({len(ocr_text)} chars)")
print(f"\\nOCR Text Preview (first 500 chars):\\n{ocr_text[:500]}")

doc.close()
'''
await write_file("./extract_pdf.py", script)
print("Script written.")
